sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash preview - Gemini API
sources.evidence: Exact model code and preview name; text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs, text output, 1,048,576 input tokens and 65,536 output tokens; Thinking and Function calling supported. Page last updated October 9, 2026.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: The December 17, 2025 entry explicitly launches Gemini 3 Flash Preview with identifier gemini-3-flash-preview.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash Model Card - December 2025
sources.evidence: Exact Flash card describes a native multimodal reasoning model based on Gemini 3 Pro, with adjustable thinking levels. Its architecture and distribution sections explicitly refer to the Pro card. No numerical total or active parameter counts appear.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card - updated May 2026
sources.evidence: The card linked by Flash identifies sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer architecture, with text, vision and audio inputs. It explicitly lists Flash among the dependent Gemini 3 models. Distribution is via Google products and APIs subject to service terms. No Flash parameter counts appear.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Model Card - May 19, 2026
sources.evidence: Later card includes an exact Gemini 3 Flash comparison column, but reports benchmarks rather than total/active parameter counts. Its architecture section refers back to the original Flash card.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash Model Card - September 2, 2026
sources.evidence: Later-card check: architecture refers to 3.7 Flash; inspected model information and comparison tables do not disclose original Gemini 3 Flash total or active parameters. No 3.8 specification is transferred to this preview.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro Model Card - February 19, 2026
sources.evidence: Later-card check: model information and comparison tables do not disclose the original Gemini 3 Flash total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card - October 13, 2026
sources.evidence: Later-card check: inspected architecture and comparison material contain no original Gemini 3 Flash total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: SFT Drives Gemini’s Safety Properties - June 13, 2026
sources.publisher: Google DeepMind Language Model Interpretability team (Josh Engels, Arthur Conmy, Bilal Chughtai, Neel Nanda)
sources.evidence: First-party research update explicitly compares Gemini 3 Flash pretraining-plus-SFT variants with its production model. It discusses training stages, without disclosing production total/active parameters or additional architectural dimensions.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API access is governed by Google API and Gemini service terms, including restrictions on extracting or replicating model parameter weights. Supports proprietary service classification; the documentation footer licenses documentation, not model weights.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 3 Flash Preview record
sources.evidence: Inspected the original catalog lead; its facts were independently checked against Google documentation and cards.

name.note: Official preview name and exact API identifier match the baseline.

developer.note: Developed and published by Google DeepMind; Google is the catalog developer label.

family.note: Normalized catalog label for the Flash branch of the Gemini 3 model series, not an official literal family identifier.

release_date.note: Explicit first public API preview launch date; not a later product rollout or successor release.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is a proprietary hosted model through products/APIs; no downloadable weight release is provided by the reviewed primary distribution sources.

license.note: Descriptive classification for the hosted model under Google service terms, not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: No numerical total for exact Gemini 3 Flash was disclosed in the inspected original/dependency cards, later comparison cards or first-party training research. No estimate or successor count is used.

active_parameters_b.note: Sparse routing is documented, but no active-parameter count for exact Gemini 3 Flash is given in the inspected sources.

architecture.note: The exact Flash architecture section explicitly delegates to Gemini 3 Pro; that linked card identifies a sparse MoE Transformer. This is documented inheritance, not inference from a sibling name. Expert counts and dimensions remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: Exact published input-token limit; output-token limit is separately 65,536. Documentation verification does not establish a successful live endpoint call.

modalities.note: Exact model table confirms all five inputs and text output. PDF is a supported document input format.

reasoning.note: Exact API entry supports Thinking; original card describes adjustable thinking levels.

tool_call.note: Exact API entry explicitly supports Function calling.

description.value: Gemini 3 Flash preview is a multimodal reasoning model with adjustable thinking levels and function calling, accepting text, images, audio, video and PDFs and generating text.
description.note: Replace vague marketing language and the time-sensitive word New with concrete documented capabilities.

patch.description: Gemini 3 Flash preview is a multimodal reasoning model with adjustable thinking levels and function calling, accepting text, images, audio, video and PDFs and generating text.

patch.notes: Architecture is a sparse MoE Transformer through the exact Flash card’s explicit reference to Gemini 3 Pro. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the inspected primary sources, including later comparison cards and exact-model training research. Context is the 1,048,576-token input limit; maximum output is separately 65,536 tokens. Specifications refer to gemini-3-flash-preview, not later Gemini 3.5/3.8 Flash models.

research_notes.parameter_search: Checked the exact Flash card, its explicit Pro architecture dependency updated May 2026, later 3.1 Pro, 3.5 Flash (including the exact Flash comparison column), 3.8 Flash and 4 Argon cards, plus exact-model Google DeepMind interpretability/training research. No numerical total or active count was found; this is limited to the sources inspected, not an assertion of exhaustive search.
research_notes.architecture_search: Targeted Google DeepMind, Google Research, arXiv and interpretability searches supplemented the direct Flash-to-Pro architecture reference. The June 13 first-party training update names production Gemini 3 Flash but supplies no extra structural dimensions.
research_notes.access: Primary pages and PDFs were accessed successfully. The Flash model-information page and the linked Pro architecture page were rendered and visually checked; cache is /tmp/model-audit-200.

summary: All 14 fields audited. Add verified MoE architecture and proprietary classification, replace vague description, and replace catalog-only provenance with primary sources. Confirm December 17, 2025 preview release, exact input limit, modalities, reasoning and function calling. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed after later-card and training-research checks.
